$comment: What this milestone ships (BUILD_PLAN 3.4, 3.6, 10.6; GAME_DESIGN 3.6, 15). S2 writes the screens, the main block and the channel swap; S3 adds the guest book and the trail (preview only: main.screens keeps them off main); S4 adds ships, park, first_trip, months, stores, jobs and switches, and the map (preview only). S6 ships the park and the odds with the trail too (the fork's walks and its Why sheets). S7 adds the home (the cabin), the lockbox and the mailbox (preview only), ships the sun table and the climate with the home, the quiz with the lockbox and the cabin's next-step table as the home section, retires the title page's words on preview (channels.preview.off: from S7b the title screen's prompt is the way in there, decision 74) and turns the real moon on. screens: the screens this build has (a line on another screen waits for it: T11). main.screens: the screens the main channel carries. main.off: lines on those screens that main leaves out, each with its reason; the fill removes them, and T14 holds every other line main reaches to the ledger. channels: per-channel id swaps for the fill, and preview's off list (lines preview leaves out, each with its reason; the fill removes them as it does main.off's on main). ships: each data section ships to a channel only when one of its listed screens is in that channel's screens; everything is compiled, validated and linted on every build, shipped or not. park: the M1a slice of the park graph, whose lists lint G08 checks. switches: the shows-and-hides, each naming its doc; tools/scope.mjs holds their registry, and R01 checks each against it.
